notes: This contract pins the private Annex C.6 transportation-type composition rule. Same-name transportation types are compared with the first definition: an identical duplicate is ignored, while any differing name/semantics/note sub-element fails composition. Referenced notes are compared by note content after Umbra's per-module label remapping, while omitted DIF fields may still be completed by a later row. This is source/test traceability only, not a public transport-service or conformance claim.
